visual_review: Selected architecture vertices are recognizable and broadly correctly placed on the same chamfered central footprint; substantial colour/rendering differences remain between reference and game overlay.
NW and SW cross centers are visible. The NE cross center is visible inside the cursor ring; the ring center is offset, so using the cross itself is appropriate.
Eastern lower cross is faint and partly overlays a map boundary; selection appears reasonable but its contrast and outside-hull position make it weaker evidence.
The missing SE grid point is near/under the player arrow and was appropriately excluded; do not derive an exact start coordinate from that icon.
The contact sheet at 20.9 and 21.0 seconds visibly shows HUD number 60. This is a displayed distance indicator, not an observed step count.
interpretation: Two in-hull horizontal/vertical intervals support approximately 240 reference-image pixels locally.
Two outside-hull intervals corroborate approximately 240 pixels but do not establish whole-city scale.
Withheld architecture vertices support local shape registration. They all belong to one footprint in one frame and are not independent geographic anchors or separate-camera validation.
Cross observations did not enter the architecture homography fit. Therefore the near-240 interval is not imposed by those cross observations in this fit.
The 240-pixel lattice origin was chosen after inspecting the transformed positions. Its residual is a descriptive local consistency metric, not independent validation of a citywide origin.

RMS subpixel held-out error is alignment residual on selected reference points, not total map/pin accuracy. It omits source map mismatch, lens distortion, manual-pick bias, image compression, and global registration uncertainty.
Picking perturbations use assumed noise levels. The reported 95-percent ranges are sensitivity percentiles, not empirical 95-percent confidence bounds on true world distance.

One 60 reading with endpoint occlusion is consistent with a roughly 60 displayed-unit interval in this demonstration. It does not establish every grid interval or distinguish rounding/slope/path/world-distance conventions.
No metres, footsteps, native engine units, 1920 Atlas coordinates, or exact item coordinates are certified.
recommended_user_wording: The crosses in this central map view form a repeatable local grid, with roughly 240 pixels between neighbouring crosses on the 4096-pixel reference image. Your video also shows 60 on the in-game distance readout for the demonstrated target. That supports the scale you noticed, while footsteps, official units and citywide exact coordinates remain unverified.
